title: Sleeping Beauty and the Magical Girl

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Hatsune and {0} had come to the Tower of Luna in search of clues to the boy's lost memories. They looked up, at a tower that soared the very heavens.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}の記憶の手がかりを求めて
ルナの塔にやってきたハツネと{0}は
天高くそびえたつ塔を見上げていた。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: So here's where we'll find a clue to your memories, {0}-kun! Wow, it's so tall, I can't even see the top!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここに{0}くんの記憶の手がかりがあるんだね！
すごく高いね～
頂上が見えないよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: That gives me an idea! Can't I just teleport us to the top using my ESP powers?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！
私の超能力で
瞬間移動できないかな？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Once I've done that, it'll be way easier to find those clues to your memories!
text_block_list.orig_text:
できちゃったら
キミの記憶の手がかりも
探しやすいよね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Now that it's been decided, let's give it a try! Come on, hold on to me. Here we go! Kira-...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうと決まったら
さっそくやってみよ～！
さ
、
私につかまって。
いっくよ～！
きらー……

text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh! What a coincidence to meet you two here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー！　
こんなところで会うとは奇遇ですな！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? That's strange. I'm pretty sure {0}-kun and Hatsune-taso were there a moment ago...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？　
おっかしいなぁ。
確かに{0}君とハツネたそが
居たと思うんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on. I'll think about prime numbers so that I can calm down. This is the Tower of Luna, a place surrounded by the most insane rumours. Could it be some kind of illusion magic?
text_block_list.orig_text:
待て待て。
素数を考えて落ち着くでござるよ。
ここは色々な噂を聞くルナの塔。
何かしらの幻影魔法という可能性もあるのでは？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: That's... KUUUUHHHHHH! The trail's getting HOT! It was worth coming here to look for some hints about new magic, after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは…………
く
ぅーーーーーー！　
燃えてきますな！
新しい魔法のヒントを探しに来たかいが
あるってもんだね！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Wait for me, o'impregnable Tower of Luna! You shall be conquered by the super strong, super cute Nanaka-ch...
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってろよ
難攻不落のルナの塔、
サイカワサイツヨな
ナナカちゃんが攻略しちゃ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? We were supposed to be moved to the top of the Tower and yet we've returned to where we were.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ？
塔の上を目指したはずなのに
さっきの場所に戻ってきちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: WH-WHAAAAAAT?! Call the authorities! A beautiful girl and {0}-kun suddenly came out of the tower!! Is this the work of another illusion magic?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なに～～！？
親方！　
塔から急に美少女と{0}君が～～！！
また幻影魔法！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: HUH?! Ah! That voice just now was Nanaka-chan, correct?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっ！？　
あ！　
さっきの声はナナカちゃんだったんだね。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: SHE SPOKE?! D-Don't tell me that it's the real Hatsune-taso?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シャベッタ！？
ま、
まさか
本物のハツネたそでござるか！？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: So that magic just now was... Hatsune-taso's?! AMAZINGGG!! It was a spell I'd never seen before! Also, if you don't mind, could you please teach me how it works?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ
さっきの魔法はハツネたその！？
す
ごい！　
見たことがない魔法だったよ！
も、
もしよければ
拙者にご教授いただけませぬか！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, um... Well... That's... Mmm, I'm getting sleepy after using my power. Sorry, I'm going to sleep for a bit...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
あ、
えっと……
それは……
んんぅ、
力を使ったから眠くなってきちゃった。
ごめん、
ちょっとだけ寝るね～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Suya~
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤ～

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: SHE'S SLEEPING?! Wh-What's going on? {0}-kun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネチャッタ！？
ど、
どういうことなの？　{0}君！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: So it's a spell that comes with a price... It must be really powerful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
代償を伴う魔法……
よっぽど強力なんだね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Suya suya~
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤスヤ～

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
That said, she has a very cute and calm sleeping face～
Looking at her makes me feel relaxed too～
text_block_list.orig_text:
にしては
穏やかでかわいらしい寝顔ですな～
見ていると癒されまする～

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: WAAAAIT! This isn't the time to be captivated. Why are you two here...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
見惚れてる場合じゃなかった。
君たちは
なんでここに居るの……？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I see! So there's a clue about your memories in there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど！
ここには君の記憶の手がかりがあるんだね！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I came looking for hints about new types of magic myself, however after hearing that Nanaka-chan can't just abandon you two... But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
新しい魔法のヒントを探しに来たんだけど、
それを聞いたらこのナナカちゃんも
協力しないわけにはいかない……
んだけど……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Suya suya~
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤスヤ～

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Let's think about what to do next after Hatsune-taso here wakes up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先のことはハツネたそが起きてから
考えよっか。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: At the entrance to the ever-soaring Tower of Luna, {0} and Nanaka were seen waiting, while listening to Hatsune's gentle breathing in her sleep.
text_block_list.orig_text:
天高くそびえるルナの塔の入り口で、
ハツネの穏やかな寝息に耳をすませる
{0}とナナカであった。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Suya suya~
text_block_list.orig_text: スヤスヤ～
